title: Encrypted Redundancy as a Diagnostic Resource: Relational Diagnosis in Quantum Encrypted Cloning
summary: Quantum encrypted cloning encodes an unknown state into several encrypted components, each offering an alternative way to recover it later. We show that this redundancy can also serve for one-shot fault diagnosis: instead of inspecting the encrypted state, we measure relational Pauli observables testing consistency conditions imposed by the encoding. The canonical Yamaguchi--Kempf scheme encodes the input into \(n\) signal--key pairs, all carrying the same coherent Bell label, plus a transformed copy of the input qubit.
